Definition
[Pullback metric and Riemannian immersion]

Source: petersen:page-0022 ↗ def:pet-ch1-riemannian-manifold

Let $F:M\to (N,g_N)$ be an immersion. Its pullback metric is \[ (F^*g_N)_p(v,w)=g_N(DF_pv,DF_pw). \] Injectivity of $DF_p$ makes this positive definite. If a metric $g_M$ is already specified, $F$ is a Riemannian or isometric immersion when $g_M=F^*g_N$; the analogous terminology applies to embeddings.
